name: openjp
description: Jurassic Park (Ocean, PC386 v1.31 / front end V 1.32P, 11/04/93) under DOSBox-X. INCOMPLETE: the data segment has not been located yet, so the marker below is a placeholder and every memory tool reports 'no data segment matching profile'. NOTE the marker offset of 0 makes the scan self-validating and gives a false 'attached: true' -- do not trust it until a real marker replaces it. The screen tools work now. Driving: this game does NOT read the BIOS keyboard ring, so dosbox_send_keys stops working the moment the game takes the keyboard; use AUTOTYPE in the .conf, which goes through the emulated keyboard controller. See docs/GROUND_TRUTH.md.

marker.note: 'game\spts\sprites.dbt', a literal in JP2D.EXE at file offset 0x1a6ba. It is certainly somewhere in the loaded image; offset 0x0000 is a placeholder and is wrong, which is why nothing validates against it yet.

mouse.note: The front end OPTIONS.OLD keeps pointer x at DS:0x21BF and y at DS:0x21C1, with the INT 33h AX=0 result at DS:0x21C7 and its data segment at load+0x2C0 (image 0x1A2F). Those are the front end's, not JP2D.EXE's. Under the current dosbox-x configs INT 33h reports no driver, so the game skips its mouse setup entirely and the menu cannot be clicked.

screen.note: Verified: the front end sets the INT 33h pointer range to 0..319 by 0..199 at OPTIONS.OLD image 0x1A49, so the mode is 320x200. No palette file yet, so dosbox_capture_screen must be called with exact=false; a decoded .PAL from the container is the obvious candidate.
